title: Elon Musk 专题 · 读他之前：四个折扣
title_en: Elon Musk Series · Before You Read Him: Four Discounts

questions.question: Musk 给出的「某年实现某事」的时间表，文章建议怎么读？
options: 是对外宽松的承诺，内部目标其实更保守、留有余量
是故意误导市场的虚假承诺，最好完全忽略不予理会
是相当严谨的工程预测，延期多半是因为外部监管审批和供应链的拖累
首先是给团队和供应商的冲刺目标，当意图读比当预测读更有信息量
questions.explanation: 他自己说内部就该定最激进的时间表，因为日程像气体一样会膨胀；文章把它比作把内部更严的 SLO 直接当 SLA 公布出去。所以内部目标比对外承诺更激进，不是更保守。
questions.question_en: How does the piece suggest reading Musk's 'X will happen by year Y' timelines?
options_en: As loose public commitments, with more conservative internal targets held in reserve
As deliberately misleading promises to the market that are best ignored entirely
As rigorous engineering forecasts that slip mostly because of regulatory delays
Mainly as sprint targets for his teams and suppliers; read as intent, not forecast, they say more
questions.explanation_en: He says internal schedules should be as aggressive as conceivable because schedules expand like a gas; the piece likens this to publishing an internal SLO as the external SLA. So internal targets are more aggressive than public ones, not more conservative.

questions.question: 文章说 Musk 讲公司史时很少提「时代窗口」。Tesla 第一个全年盈利的 2020 年，账本上哪一点最能说明这个折扣？
options: NASA 签下的大额货运合同为 Tesla 提供了主要现金流
Model 3 量产后单车毛利大幅提升，盈利几乎全靠工程效率
卖给其他车企的监管积分收入超过全年净利润，没有它就会亏损
垂直整合降低了电池成本，使利润在一年内迅速转正
questions.explanation: 2020 年净利润 7.21 亿美元，而法规逼出来的监管积分收入是 15.8 亿美元。NASA 的 16 亿美元合同救的是 2008 年的 SpaceX，不是 Tesla。
questions.question_en: The piece says Musk rarely mentions the 'window of the era' when telling company history. In 2020, Tesla's first full profitable year, what in the books best illustrates this discount?
options_en: A large NASA cargo contract provided Tesla's main cash flow
Model 3 mass production raised per-car margins, so profit came almost entirely from engineering
Regulatory credit sales to other automakers exceeded net income; without them it would have lost money
Vertical integration cut battery costs and turned profit positive within a year
questions.explanation_en: Net income was $721 million while regulation-created credit sales were $1.58 billion. The $1.6 billion NASA contract rescued SpaceX in 2008, not Tesla.

questions.question: 关于 2018 年「资金已到位」的推文，Musk 说陪审团一致认定他无罪。按文章核查，那次裁决实际说明了什么？
options: 陪审团认定推文内容属实，只是发布的时机不太恰当
陪审团认定他当时确实已经拿到了私有化所需的资金
投资者没能证明受损；法官事先已认定推文不实且出于轻率
裁决证明 SEC 的指控根本不成立，当年的和解完全是被银行所逼
questions.explanation: 法官 Edward Chen 在开庭前已裁定推文不实且出于轻率，并要求陪审团照此看待；陪审团判的是投资者没能证明受损，不是推文为真。所以「有据，但说宽了」。
questions.question_en: On his 2018 'funding secured' tweet, Musk says a jury unanimously found him not liable. Per the piece's fact-check, what did that verdict actually establish?
options_en: The jury found the tweet true but poorly timed
The jury found he really had secured the funding needed to take Tesla private
Investors failed to prove damages; the judge had already ruled the tweet false and reckless
It proved the SEC's charges baseless and that the settlement was forced by banks
questions.explanation_en: Judge Edward Chen ruled before trial that the tweet was false and made recklessly, and instructed the jury accordingly; the jury found investors hadn't proven harm, not that the tweet was true. Hence: grounded, but overstated.
